description: This file contains unit tests for the Encounter class within the OpenMRS project. It verifies behaviors such as adding and removing observations (Obs), conditions, orders, providers, and other Encounter-related functionalities, including deep hierarchy handling of Obs and role-based provider management.

classes.name: EncounterTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that validates various methods and behaviors of the Encounter class in OpenMRS, including Obs hierarchy, provider management, condition handling, and copying encounters.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method initializing an Encounter with conditions before each test.

methods.name: toString_shouldNotFailWithEmptyObject
methods.description: Verifies that the toString method of Encounter does not throw an exception even when the object is empty.

methods.name: removeObs_shouldRemoveObsSuccessfully
methods.description: Tests that an Obs can be successfully removed from an Encounter.

methods.name: removeObs_shouldNotThrowErrorWhenRemovingNullObsFromEmptySet
methods.description: Ensures no error occurs when attempting to remove null Obs from an Encounter with no Obs.

methods.name: removeObs_shouldNotThrowErrorWhenRemovingNullObsFromNonEmptySet
methods.description: Ensures no error occurs when attempting to remove null Obs from an Encounter with existing Obs.

methods.name: getObs_shouldNotReturnNullWithNullObsSet
methods.description: Checks that getObs returns an empty set rather than null.

methods.name: getAllObs_shouldNotReturnNullWithNullObsSet
methods.description: Checks that getAllObs returns a non-null collection even if no Obs exist.

methods.name: getAllObs_shouldGetObsInTheSameOrderObsIsAddedToTheEncounter
methods.description: Verifies that getAllObs returns Obs in the order they were added.

methods.name: getObsAtTopLevel_shouldNotReturnNullWithNullObsSet
methods.description: Verifies getObsAtTopLevel returns non-null collection even with no Obs.

methods.name: getObsAtTopLevel_shouldGetObsInTheSameOrderObsIsAddedToTheEncounter
methods.description: Verifies order of getObsAtTopLevel matches insertion order.

methods.name: getObs_shouldGetObsInTheSameOrderObsIsAddedToTheEncounter
methods.description: Checks getObs returns Obs in added order.

methods.name: getObs_shouldGetObs
methods.description: Checks that getObs returns the correct set of Obs after addition.

methods.name: getObsAtTopLevel_shouldGetObs
methods.description: Checks that getObsAtTopLevel returns the correct top-level Obs.

methods.name: getAllObs_shouldGetObs
methods.description: Verifies that getAllObs returns all Obs including nested ones.

methods.name: getObs_shouldNotGetVoidedObs
methods.description: Confirms voided Obs are excluded from getObs.

methods.name: getObsAtTopLevel_shouldNotGetVoidedObs
methods.description: Confirms voided Obs are excluded from getObsAtTopLevel(false).

methods.name: getAllObs_shouldNotGetVoidedObs
methods.description: Confirms voided Obs are excluded from getAllObs(true).

methods.name: getObs_shouldOnlyGetChildObs
methods.description: Asserts getObs returns only leaf or non-grouping Obs.

methods.name: getObsAtTopLevel_shouldOnlyGetParentsObs
methods.description: Confirms getObsAtTopLevel returns only parent Obs, not children.

methods.name: getAllObs_shouldGetBothParentAndChildObs
methods.description: Verifies getAllObs includes both parent and child Obs.

methods.name: getObs_shouldNotGetChildObsIfChildAlsoOnEncounter
methods.description: Test that getObs does not return child Obs if they are explicitly added to the Encounter separately.

methods.name: getObsAtTopLevel_shouldOnlyReturnTheGroupedTopLevelObs
methods.description: Verifies that getObsAtTopLevel only includes top-level Obs, ignoring nested groups if specified.

methods.name: getAllObs_shouldGetBothParentAndChildWithChildDirectlyOnEncounter
methods.description: Checks getAllObs returns both parent and child Obs when children are directly added.

methods.name: getObs_shouldGetObsWithTwoLevelsOfHierarchy
methods.description: Tests recursive retrieval of Obs at multiple hierarchy levels.

methods.name: getObs_shouldGetObsWithThreeLevelsOfHierarchy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of Obs in a deep hierarchy of multiple levels.

methods.name: getObs_shouldNotGetVoidedObsWithThreeLayersOfHierarchy
methods.description: Verifies that voided Obs at various hierarchy levels are excluded.

methods.name: Encounter_shouldSetEncounterId
methods.description: Tests constructor initializing encounterId.

methods.name: addObs_shouldAddObsWithNullValues
methods.description: Checks adding Obs without setting fields.

methods.name: addObs_shouldNotFailWithNullObs
methods.description: Ensures no error when adding null Obs.

methods.name: addObs_shouldSetEncounterAttributeOnObs
methods.description: Verifies that added Obs has its encounter attribute set.

methods.name: addObs_shouldAddObsToNonNullInitialObsSet
methods.description: Tests adding Obs when initial set is already non-null.

methods.name: addObs_shouldAddEncounterAttrsToObsIfAttributesAreNull
methods.description: Checks that encounter date, location, and patient are propagated to Obs and group members if null.

methods.name: addObs_shouldAddEncounterAttrsToObsGroupMembersIfAttributesAreNull
methods.description: Verifies propagation of encounter attributes to groups and nested group members.

methods.name: addOrder_shouldAddOrderWithNullValues
methods.description: Tests adding Order with default/ null fields.

methods.name: addOrder_shouldNotFailWithNullObsPassedToAddOrder
methods.description: Ensures no error when adding null Order.

methods.name: addOrder_shouldSetEncounterAttribute
methods.description: Verifies Order has its encounter set.

methods.name: addOrder_shouldAddOrderToNonNullInitialOrderSet
methods.description: Tests adding Order when initial orders set exists.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Checks that added Orders are retrievable.

methods.name: removeOrder_shouldRemoveOrderFromEncounter
methods.description: Verifies removal of an Order from Encounter.

methods.name: removeOrder_shouldNotFailWhenRemovingNullOrder
methods.description: Checks safe handling when removing null Order.

methods.name: removeOrder_shouldNotFailWhenRemovingNonExistentOrder
methods.description: Checks safe handling of removal when Order not present.

methods.name: addCondition_shouldSetEncounterAttribute
methods.description: Tests adding a Condition to the Encounter.

methods.name: removeCondition_shouldNotFailWhenRemovingNonExistentCondition
methods.description: Ensures safe removal of a Condition not in the Encounter.

methods.name: removeCondition_shouldRemoveConditionFromEncounter
methods.description: Verifies Condition removal from Encounter.

methods.name: addProvider_shouldAddProviderForNewRole
methods.description: Tests adding a Provider to an Encounter for a new role.

methods.name: addProvider_shouldAddSecondProviderForRole
methods.description: Checks multiple Providers for same Role.

methods.name: addProvider_shouldNotAddSameProviderTwiceForRole
methods.description: Ensures the same provider isn't duplicated.

methods.name: getProvidersByRole_shouldReturnEmptySetForNoRole
methods.description: Tests empty set when role has no Providers.

methods.name: getProvidersByRole_shouldReturnEmptySetForNullRole
methods.description: Test null role input handling.

methods.name: getProvidersByRole_shouldReturnProvidersForRole
methods.description: Verify Providers retrieved correctly for a given role.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles_shouldReturnAllRolesAndProviders
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all role-Provider mappings.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles_shouldReturnEmptyMapIfNoProviders
methods.description: Ensures empty map when no Providers scheduled.

methods.name: setProvider_shouldClearProvidersAndSetProviderForRole
methods.description: Tests replacing all Providers for a role.

methods.name: setProvider_shouldSetProviderForNewRole
methods.description: Validates setting Provider for a new role.

methods.name: setProvider_shouldVoidExistingEncounterProvider
methods.description: Checks that existing Providers are voided when setting a new one.

methods.name: removeProvider_shouldVoidExistingEncounterProvider
methods.description: Verifies provider voiding on removal.

methods.name: copy_shouldCopyAllEncounterDataExceptVisitAndAssignCopiedEncounterToGivenPatient
methods.description: Tests deep copy of an Encounter, excluding visit, assigning to specified patient.

methods.name: multipleAddingAndRemovingOfSameProvider_shouldNotFail
methods.description: Ensures idempotent add/remove provider operations.

methods.name: hasDiagnosis_shouldReturnTrueIfEncounterHasDiagnosis
methods.description: Checks if Encounter correctly reports presence of a specific diagnosis.

methods.name: hasDiagnosis_shouldReturnFalseIfEncounterDoesNotHaveDiagnosis
methods.description: Checks correct false response when diagnosis not present.

methods.name: getConditions_shouldReturnAllConditionsWhenFlagIsTrue
methods.description: Validates retrieval of all conditions, including voided ones.

methods.name: getConditions_shouldReturnNonVoidedConditionsByDefault
methods.description: Verifies default behavior of getConditions excludes voided.

methods.name: removeCondition_shouldRemoveConditions
methods.description: Tests that removing a condition voids it appropriately.
